subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class durable subagent lifecycle and supervision API now, and what is the minimal public contract?
rationale: The missing behavior crosses persisted state, Gateway protocol, task/artifact/audit boundaries, and security-sensitive control semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the stable API shape.

options.title: Design bounded core receipt API
options.body: Add a metadata-only ordered subagent lifecycle receipt linked to tasks/artifacts/audit plus audited cancel, steer, and resume semantics as the core contract.

options.title: Keep the current task ledger and split narrow fixes
options.body: Leave the broad contract undecided and address only channel-specific liveness or UI timeline requests in their narrower issues.

options.title: Route observability to plugins after adding seams
options.body: Keep core minimal and expose only missing generic hooks needed for external plugins or dashboards to build richer views.

recommendation.title: Design bounded core receipt API
recommendation.body: Add a metadata-only ordered subagent lifecycle receipt linked to tasks/artifacts/audit plus audited cancel, steer, and resume semantics as the core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent background task UI/runtime work makes @steipete the strongest available owner for choosing how much of this belongs in core task and gateway surfaces.
